correctness.rationale: The product of the radical lands in its one-dimensional annihilator Z=A²; any d-subspace containing Z is closed and counted by [2r,d−1]_q. If H∩Z=0, closure forces H²=0; it is a graph lift over a subspace S⊂U⊕V, with q^d choices of central functional. The U and V projections of S must be pairwise orthogonal, counted by [r a]_q[r−a b]_q. The linear Goursat correspondence classifies S through a common quotient of dimension t, with [a t]_q[b t]_q|GL_t(q)| possibilities and dim S=a+b−t. This proves exact sum and sharp d≤r; equality requires t=0 and b=r−a. Independent complete subspace enumeration over F2 for r=1,2 confirmed each dimension census. Characteristic 2 and nonprime fields are covered by the field-linear proof, not the small test.
